messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — final RN draft for tomorrow's microrelease (v1.8.2). Target deploy window 03:00 UTC. Need pin owners, canary cadence, and rollback thresholds. DeployBot will run canary at +5m.
Maria: Reviewed copy, LGTM except one microcopy tweak on the user-facing line 2. I'll paste revision.
Maria: Replace "improved latency" -> "improved inference latency (median)" — keeps us honest.
Jun: Who is pin owner for EU? We need someone to monitor metrics 03:00-05:00 UTC.
Sylvia: I can take EU standby for this window. Will be on call and reachable via DM.
Alex: Thanks @Sylvia. Maria, can you be primary for US/Global? @Jun you do APAC standby?
Jun: Yup, APAC standby is fine. I'll set a pager alert threshold for the canary group.
Maria: Rollback criteria proposal: error rate increase >2% absolute OR 4xx/5xx spike >100% vs baseline OR median latency >150% baseline over 3 min. Any objections?
Alex: That seems reasonable. Add a secondary check: spammy regression in top 10 prompts -> rollback.
Jun: Noted. Deploybot runbook id: deploybot:microrelease-1733333. Canary cadence: 5% -> 20% after 10m -> full after 30m if green.
DeployBot: Scheduled canary set: microrelease-1733333 — canary at 03:05 UTC, escalation hooks enabled. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Sylvia: :thumbsup:
Jun: :thumbsup: I'll post alert links and the dashboard tile in a sec.
Alex: Internal RN snippet for announcement — paste below, use short bullet in staff channel:
Maria: "Tomorrow 03:00 UTC — small service update (v1.8.2). Canary rollout with rollback triggers; EU standby: Sylvia; APAC standby: Jun; US: Maria. See deploy runbook microrelease-1733333."
Alex: Perfect. I'll pin the RN and notify the ops channel 1h before. Thanks all.
